method: Exact static output, ordinary visitor URLs without test/profile parameters or scene hooks. Native keyboard events drive the car. DOM focus selects native menu controls. Read-only HUD/storage observations and an AudioContext construction counter provide evidence; no vehicle state/control injection. Isolated headless ANGLE D3D11; actual graph enabled with host output muted. Not performance scoring or physical-controller/listening approval.

steps.name: Native Tab/Enter entry and readable 720p grid controls
steps.controls:
Controls & race rules

W / S pedals · A / D steering · C camera · hold B look back · Esc pause · X direction · hold R one second to restart.

Controller: RT / LT pedals · left stick steering · top face camera · hold LB look back · Menu pause.

Two clean laps through every checkpoint. Stay within the course. Credits are awarded only for a valid finish.

Enter / bottom face confirm · Backspace / right face garage
